//! The test-feature canary of the Core crates' lib.rs files, in a crate of
//! its own (scripts/test-feature-canary-selftest.sh builds it).

pub fn add(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 {
    a + b
}

// Test-feature canary. A test build of this crate without its test feature
// fails to compile while MEERKAT_WORKSPACE_TEST_FEATURES is set (the
// repository's .cargo/config.toml sets it). Only code generation instantiates
// the generic function below (a test binary does), so `cargo check`, clippy
// and an editor's check run, which generate no code, are not stopped by it.
#[cfg(all(test, not(feature = "canary-test-feature")))]
mod test_features_canary {
    fn require<T>() {
        const {
            let _ = size_of::<T>();
            assert!(
                option_env!("MEERKAT_WORKSPACE_TEST_FEATURES").is_none(),
                "test-feature-canary-fixture: this repository's test builds need the crate's test features: \
                 `cargo test -p test-feature-canary-fixture --features canary-test-feature` \
                 (core-workspace-args.mjs --tests prints the flags for any selection)"
            );
        }
    }

    #[used]
    static REQUIRE: fn() = require::<()>;
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn adds() {
        assert_eq!(super::add(1, 2), 3);
    }
}
